items.title: US lacks moral or legal standing to demand reopening of Strait of Hormuz: Iran
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says Iran’s move to close the shipping through the Strait of Hormuz was in response to the continued US aggressive actions against the country, arguing that Washington has no moral or legal standing to demand the reopening of the strategic waterway.

items.title: How significant is Mohsen Rezaee’s appointment as Iran’s security chief?
items.summary: Former IRGC commander Rezaee will be taking over as secretary of Iran's top security body amid Hormuz talks.

items.title: Iran, Oman continue talks on safe shipping route through Strait of Hormuz: FM spokesperson
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iran and Oman are continuing negotiations on a mechanism for safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, with the two sides yet to finalize a joint statement on the issue, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says.

items.title: Iran parliament to decide fate of Caspian Sea convention: Foreign Ministry spokesperson
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baqaei has stressed that the country independently makes decisions on international agreements based on its national interests, saying the final decision on the Convention on the Legal Status of the Caspian Sea rests with the Iranian Parliament.
